headers.name: backward_increment_of_concave
headers.header:
theorem backward_increment_of_concave
    (hconc : ConcaveOn ℝ (Icc (2 : ℝ) 4) firstF)
    {s b u : ℝ} (hs2 : 2 ≤ s - u) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hsb : s ≤ b) (hb4 : b ≤ 4) :
    Q b u ≤ firstF s - firstF (s - u)

headers.name: gatedProfile_eq_first
headers.header:
theorem gatedProfile_eq_first (lambda : ℝ) (t : Point)
    (ht : 0 < t 4)
    (hfour : max 2 (residual lambda t) ≤ 4) :
    primeOwnCubeGatedProfile lambda t =
      (4 / t 4) * firstF (max 2 (residual lambda t))

headers.name: frozenUpperPositiveKernel_ge_Q
headers.header:
theorem frozenUpperPositiveKernel_ge_Q
    (hconc : ConcaveOn ℝ (Icc (2 : ℝ) 4) firstF)
    (picks : ParentPicks) (raw : FifthWireRow)
    (t : Point) (ht : ∀ i : Fin 5, 0 < t i)
    (b : ℝ) (hb2 : 2 < b) (hb4 : b ≤ 4)
    (hnew : residual (rawCandidate 0 raw t) t ≤ b) :
    (4 / t 4) * (∏ i : Fin 5, 1 / t i) *
        Q b (max 0 (frozenGap picks raw t) / t 4) ≤
      frozenUpperPositiveKernel picks raw t
